title: 存档与帐篷
text: 进入帐篷后选择保存游戏。帐篷也是装备饰物和使用商店等服务的据点；服务会随推进逐步开放。探索新区域前，先确认附近的帐篷位置。
textEn: Enter a tent and choose Save Game. Tents also let you equip trinkets and use services that open as you progress. Locate a nearby tent before exploring a new area.

title: 油瓶与恢复
text: 油瓶可以重新点燃火柴，并暂时强化攻击；到达存盘点后会补满。猎人的吊坠可以延长治疗判定时间，但不增加生命上限。继续探索或挑战首领前，先检查补给和装备效果。
textEn: Oil bottles relight the match, temporarily strengthen attacks and refill at save points. The Hunter's Pendant extends the healing timing window rather than increasing maximum health. Check supplies and equipment effects before exploring or fighting a boss.

title: 饰物装备与工坊升级
text: 饰物在存档帐篷内装备，每件饰物占用相应数量的饰物槽；收集更多饰物槽可以扩展搭配空间。部分饰物可在工坊升级，每次升级需要货币和 1 个工坊代币，升级不会增加原有槽位消耗。购买前以菜单显示的价格为准。
textEn: Equip trinkets inside save tents. Each uses slots, so collecting more slots expands your loadout options. Eligible trinkets can be upgraded at the workshop using currency and one Workshop Token per upgrade; their slot cost stays unchanged. Check the menu price before buying.

title: 地图、标记与回访
text: 帐篷地图可帮助查找主要目标和遗漏收集；收集标记只针对已经到过的房间，不代表尚未探索的区域已经清空。可以缩放地图并添加标记，遇到暂时无法通过的支路时，记下位置，获得相关能力后再回访。
textEn: Tent maps help locate major objectives and missed collectibles. Collectible markers cover rooms you have visited, not unexplored areas. Zoom the map and add markers to blocked branches, then revisit them after obtaining the required ability.

title: 商店与价格折扣
text: 帐篷商店的货品和服务随游戏进度变化，包含饰物、饰物槽及部分消耗品。女王硬币会降低帐篷内的购买价格；工坊升级仍需工坊代币。是否购买应结合当前装备、探索目标和菜单价格判断。
textEn: Tent shop stock changes with progression and includes trinkets, slots and some consumables. The Queen's Coin reduces tent purchase prices, but workshop upgrades still require Workshop Tokens. Compare your equipment, exploration goals and displayed prices before buying.
